lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Well, well, it seems I got too excited and ended up transforming.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: And still you lost.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Thanks to you, my mind has cleared. I should complete what I originally came to do.
*Shuuuuu*

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: *Cough*

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: You pitiful creature.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: I will gradually increase the concentration of Alva Particles here,

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: until you're paralyzed entirely.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Then I'll give you half of that brave human imposter as a present.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: This time, I think I'll split her in half vertically.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Argh...!
*Shoooo*

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: *Cough* Argh...!

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Good, that's much better.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Tell me, why don't you abandon this place?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Is it really because of those seeds?

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Not just for that... *Cough* Of course not. *Cough*

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Then for what?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Is it because of what you human imposters pontificate about, your "sense of duty"? Your pride? Doing everything for the sake of mankind's future?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Answer me.
*Shoooooooo*

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: These could be your final words.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Surely you haven't forgotten what you're willing to die for?

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: This place... *Cough*

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Is meant to last into the future.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: It represents the dream we have all been longing for.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Rooms where you can sleep at night without crying.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: *Cough* *Cough*

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Restaurants.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Gardens.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Places of worship.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: An area for oneself.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: All of these precious places and more can be found here. *Cough*

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: That is why I will protect it,

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: even if it means giving up my life for it.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Pathetic.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: None of that belongs to you.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: It all belongs to others.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: That is what a king should aspire to be.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: To exist to fulfill the wishes of their subjects,

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: while paying no heed to their own wishes.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Urgh...!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: I must hollow myself out, so that my own desires do not muddy the waters.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: What a fool you are.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Life is about chasing your desires.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: There is no reason to give others any consideration.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: I am the king.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: My own existence is meaningless. I live for my subjects.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: You've really convinced yourself of this royal delusion, haven't you?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Drowning in the desires of others, suppressing your true self.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: What's so noble and grand about that? Where's the beauty in it?

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Someone like you would never understand.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Someone who only focuses on your own desires and lives solely for yourself.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: ... I see.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: You've made your point. Now it's time to say goodbye.
*Shoooo*

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Argh...!

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Hehe, does it hurt?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: You're all about embracing others' wishes, are you not?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Well, my wish is for you to die.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Crown!

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I'm coming! Just hold on!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: No need for that.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: What are you saying?!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: *Cough cough* Argh...! Ugh!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Don't go. There's no point.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Chime...

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: why are you smiling?

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Urgh...

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: How long I have waited for this day.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: *Cough* *Cough*

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: And now it's finally here.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Don't tell me...

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: No. It can't be.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Haha.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I won.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: What... is this...!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: This device is known as the Naked King.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: It was originally a device which absorbed Alva Particles and converted them into thermal energy.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: It was then modified by a wandering monk into a weapon of mass destruction.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Even the slightest movement from the user generates thermal shockwaves.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Those who wear the robe are not affected by shockwaves. I have heard theories about the science behind it, but I do not know the details.
Crown waves her hand as if making a signal.
*Pooooow*
The Raptures in front of the gate vaporize instantaneously.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: But what does it matter?

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Feast your eyes upon her.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: To defeat the enemies that would besiege your kingdom with a mere gesture.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Such majestic armor truly befits a king.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I... I don't understand.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Your Highness came here intentionally

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: to collect enough Alva Particles for herself.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: All of her coughing fits and pain were an inconvenient side effect.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: As things were, she would have had to continue collecting particles for another year before unlocking her abilities.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: But now, thanks to this Heretic spewing out such massive amounts of Alva Particles, she's been able to accomplish this much sooner.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Precisely.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: We originally intended to use it in the upcoming battle,

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: but this will do as well.

lines.speaker: crown_n
lines.text: Chime.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Yes, Your Highness?

lines.speaker: crown_n
lines.text: Come down and make your wish come true.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Understood!

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: You tricked me!
*Pooooow*

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Argh...!
*Pooooow*

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Argh...!
*Pooooow*

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Ugh...! Gah...!
Indivilia is left writhing, her body torn to shreds.
Crown, without even granting her the dignity of a glance, walks towards the gate,
waves her hand at the throng of Raptures congregating at the entrance,
and decimates the entire horde.
The entire time,
her poise remains unaffected.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Argh...!

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Why can't I regenerate...?!
Chime stands in front of Indivilia.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Human... imposter...

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Look at you now.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: You should have killed me when you had the chance.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I knew that my king would make my wish come true.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: And you know what my wish is?
*Slice*
*Thud*

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Revenge.
The blade Chime was holding shatters and disappears.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Well done.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: You were able to utilize the Naked King.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: While it's somewhat unfortunate that we had to use it here, the fact that we came out on top is a miracle.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: What happened to Kilo and T.A.L.O.S.?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: They're both asleep.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Pssh, to think you were nearly wiped out by that pathetic specimen, Chatterbox.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: I know. It's embarrassing.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Cut them some slack. Who knew Chatterbox would end up being such a formidable foe?

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I was being only half serious.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Were it not for you, the kingdom would've been destroyed long ago.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Haha. Do you really think so?
Crown turns and slowly walks back from the gate,
her hair gracefully fluttering behind her with each dignified stride she takes.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Yes. Although, in all honesty, and please do not take offense,

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: so long as the king remains here,

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: this kingdom will endure to the end.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: ... Yes. Of course.

lines.speaker: crown_n
lines.text: Everyone.

lines.speaker: crown_n
lines.text: Our last stand has ended in victory.

lines.speaker: crown_n
lines.text: Let us drink this evening and raise a toast.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Oh my gosh! Just witnessing the lady's majesty alone is enough to make me feel intoxicated.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: First off, we should get her dressed.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: I agree.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Huh? Why? I like her this way just fine.
